# testkit

> Shared test utilities for Rust: test databases with RAII cleanup, Axum-based
> HTTP test servers on random ports, auth helpers, and assertion macros.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): test utility semantics, feature list, usage.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-TK-001..200 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model and security mitigations.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
